learning.why: Teacher connected the earlier tunnel observation to a benefit for plants, and the board shows 'water enters soil', which clicked.

end.summary:
Discussed ants and earthworms as animals found in soil.
Identified that soil tunnels allow water to soak in faster.
Connected tunnels with water reaching plant roots.
The child was unsure about earthworms eating leaves and changing soil.
Teach-back was not passed; the lesson ended when Pihu said they were tired.
end.parentNote: Pihu practised linking soil tunnels with faster water soaking and explained that plants can get water through the tunnels. They were still unsure about what earthworms do with leaves and whether worms make soil worse; this was not corrected before stopping. At home, you can look at a small patch of soil together and talk about how tunnels affect water movement.
